canonical_statement: Let p : E -> X be a covering map and let A be a preconnected topological space. If two continuous maps g1, g2 : A -> E have the same composite with p and agree at one specified point of A, then g1 = g2.
domain_and_universes: universes u v w; E : Type u; X : Type v; A : Type w; independently supplied topologies; Prop in universe 0
ordered_binders: p composed with g1 = p composed with g2

encoding_decisions.variant: general uniqueness of lifts, not path-lift existence or analytic uniformization
encoding_decisions.connectedness: PreconnectedSpace A, matching the pinned Proposition 1.34 API and allowing the empty domain only vacuously because an explicit a : A is later required
encoding_decisions.lift_equation: function equality p composed with g1 = p composed with g2; a checked iff transports to pointwise projection equality
encoding_decisions.initial_value: agreement at an arbitrary explicitly bound witness a : A
encoding_decisions.projection: IsCoveringMap p; no extra Hausdorff or local-homeomorphism hypothesis is added
